title: Rational Transductors
abstract: arXiv:2602.07599v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard Transformers excel at semantic modeling but struggle with   rigid sequential logic and state tracking. Theoretical work   establishes that self-attention is limited to $\AC^0$ (under hard   attention) or $\TC^0$ (under soft attention), complexity classes   that often fail to support robust length generalization on   sequential problems without intermediate chain-of-thought   \citep{hahn2020theoretical, hao2022formal, merrill2022saturated}. In this   work, we introduce \emph{Rational Transductors}, a dual-stream   architecture that augments the Transformer with a matrix-valued   recurrence derived from Weighted Finite Automata (WFA). translated_abstract: 标准Transformer在语义建模方面表现出色，但在处理严格的序列逻辑与状态追踪方面存在困难。已有理论工作证明，自注意力机制的表达能力被限制在 $\AC^0$（硬注意力情形）或 $\TC^0$（软注意力情形）复杂度类内，而这些复杂度类通常无法在不借助中间思维链的情况下，在序列问题上实现稳健的长度泛化。在这项工作中，我们提出了有理转换器，这是一种双流架构，通过源自加权有限自动机（WFA）的矩阵值递归来增强Transformer。通过一种深度有理注入方案将有理状态信息注入注意力机制，我们的框架严格推广了Transformer的表达能力，使其能够捕获所有正则语言、$\NC^1$完全语言（例如 $S_5$ 的字问题），以及……
tldr: 本文提出有理转换器这一双流架构，通过将源自加权有限自动机的矩阵值递归以深度有理注入的方式嵌入Transformer注意力机制，将Transformer的表达能力严格推广至可捕获所有正则语言及 $\NC^1$ 完全语言，从而解决其在序列逻辑与状态追踪上的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Rational Transductors, a dual-stream architecture that augments Transformers with a matrix-valued recurrence derived from Weighted Finite Automata via a Deep Rational Injection scheme, strictly generalizing their expressive power to capture all Regular Languages and $\NC^1$-complete languages while overcoming limitations in sequential logic and state tracking.
